people.name: Enosh
people.line: Son of Seth, during whose time people called on the Lord's name.

people.name: Seth
people.line: Third son of Adam and Eve, ancestor of righteous line

translations.web: A son was also born to Seth, and he named him Enosh. At that time men began to call on Yahweh’s name.
translations.bsb: And to Seth also a son was born, and he called him Enosh. At that time men began to call upon the name of the LORD.
translations.kjv: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of the LORD.
translations.asv: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enosh. Then began men to call upon the name of Jehovah.
